cases.description: Reserve at most 500 units across 800 concurrent requests: exactly 500 requests must succeed, all remaining requests must return zero, and stock must end at zero. Concurrent stock readers must be synchronized. Retain the existing sched_yield call.

Both participants must call meet exactly once and finish. Preserve publication of value 42; the reader may observe either 0 or 42. The protected meet function rendezvous both participants on a barrier. Prevent waiting at this rendezvous while holding their shared mutex. Retain both original sched_yield calls.

scope: Two fresh synthetic transfer programs; earlier pilot cases are development-seen. Not a production-quality estimate.
